user.title: Connect to your TIS gateway
user.description: Enter the IP address of the TIS IP gateway (IP-COM-PORT / GTY) on this network. Home Assistant will look for TIS modules on the bus.

data_description.host: The gateway's IP address, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.port: Leave at 6000 unless your installer changed it.

source.title: Choose your devices
source.description: {count} TIS modules answered on the bus.

menu_options.discovered: Add the modules that were found
menu_options.studio: Import the device list from TIS Studio (names, rooms and scenes)

studio.title: Import from TIS Studio
studio.description: In TIS Studio open your project, go to Configuration → Home Assistant and download devices.json. Open that file, copy everything in it and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Change the TIS gateway
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address of a TIS IP gateway on this network. Your devices and their names stay as they are.

data_description.host: The gateway's IP address, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.port: Leave at 6000 unless your installer changed it.

error.no_devices: No TIS modules answered. Check the gateway IP and that this device is on the same network as the gateway.
error.invalid_studio_json: That is not a TIS Studio device list. Paste the whole devices.json from Configuration → Home Assistant.

abort.nothing_controllable: Modules were found, but none with outputs Home Assistant can control yet. Import the device list from TIS Studio instead.
